title: The FAST Standard
source: FAST Standard Organisation, The FAST Standard: Practical, structured design rules for financial modelling, version 02c, July 2019. The rule numbers are FAST's.
note: Scope 'every' applies to any workbook with formulas and the app checks the scripted ones; scope 'financial model' applies to a model.

rules.text: The model lives in one workbook, with no links to other workbooks.
Inputs, workings, presentation and control are kept on separate sheets.
Logic flows left to right across sheets and top to bottom within one.
Nothing is hidden: no hidden rows, columns, sheets or outline groups.
A formula stays the same along its row unless it is marked as temporary.
Formulas are short and never run over several lines.
No nested IF formulas; flags do the work instead.
No number is typed into a formula apart from universal ones such as 12 or 1000; an assumption sits in its own labelled cell.
Every line item has its own label.
Every line item states its unit.
